thread:
Hana: Quick heads-up Our weekly KPI review shows a divergence between the launch-post cohort and the benchmark narrative cohort. Launch-posts down ~30% MQL MoM but benchmark cohort (control) flat. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/launch-vs-benchmark

Luis: Hmm, is this attribution or creative performance? The A/B benchmark cohort uses last-touch while launch-posts are recorded via UTM-first-touch in the dashboard. Could be metric mismatch.

Priya: Confirmed: two pipelines. Dashboard query: `SELECT cohort, sum(mqls) FROM kpis WHERE date >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY cohort` but the cohorts are tagged differently at ingestion.

Nora: The webinar traffic was routed through comms.provider.com; they add a redirect param `src=webinar`. Our ingest rule maps `src` -> channel but not to campaign. So webinar leads might be falling into the benchmark bucket.

analytics-bot: Alert: cohort_mismatch detected for cohorts: launch-posts vs launch-benchmark. Ratio drift 0.62. Details: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/4922

Hana: Proposal: 1) normalize cohort definition in the KPI ETL to use `campaign` precedence over `src`, 2) re-run the benchmark vs launch comparison for the last 30 days, 3) add note in this week's KPI deck about metric definition change.

Luis: +1. Also suggest we include a micro-run: compare landing conversion for launches that have `utm_campaign` vs those with only `src=webinar`. That will tell us if creative or routing is main driver.

Priya: I'll open an issue and a tiny ETL PR. Quick SQL for the micro-run:
```sql
SELECT source_label, COUNT(*) as leads, SUM(is_mql::int) as mqls
FROM registrations
WHERE created_at >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY source_label;
```
I'll attach results to the ticket.

Nora: Can ops confirm whether comms.provider changed redirect behavior around Mar 10? That would explain the timing. @mktg-ops FYI.

analytics-bot: Note: reprocessing last 7 days may change reported MQLs for the KPI board. Use tag `reprocess-4922` to track.

Hana: For the deck: I'll add a slide called "Metric alignment: launch vs benchmark" with the proposed remediation and the expected impact. If reprocessing alters numbers, we'll show both raw and normalized figures.

Luis: Also add a short recommendation: standardize on campaign-first for attribution in the KPI spec to avoid future mismatches.

Priya: PR opened: #8248. Setting reprocess window to 72h for initial run. Will post the results here when done.

Hana: Great. Let's review in the KPI sync on Friday. Thanks all :rocket:
